title: Administrator
description:
Temporary Administrator

Immediate Start

35 hours per week Monday to Friday Office Based

Our client is looking for an experienced Administrator to join their busy team on a temporary basis. This role is providing sickness cover and is expected to last for a minimum of one month, with the possibility of extension thereafter, although this cannot currently be guaranteed.

This is a varied back-office administration role supporting a busy operational team. The successful candidate will be responsible for a range of administrative duties and will play a key role in ensuring the smooth running of day-to-day office operations.

Key Responsibilities
- Processing and managing Purchase Orders
- Monitoring and managing the information inbox
- Handling incoming and outgoing mail
- Ordering and maintaining office stationery supplies
- Processing Direct Debit cancellations
- Preparing administrative documentation and reports
- Accurately updating and maintaining records and databases
- Providing reception cover when required
- General administrative support to the wider team

Skills & Experience Required
- Previous administration experience
- Strong Microsoft Office skills
- Experience using Teams and other office systems
- Excellent organisational and communication skills
- High level of accuracy and attention to detail
- Ability to manage a varied workload and work independently

Hours & Benefits
- Immediate start available
- Minimum one-month assignment with potential for extension
- Monday to Friday, 35 hours per week
- Office-based role with free parking available
- Office hours are 9:00am to 4:30pm, with some flexibility available regarding working pattern

This is an excellent opportunity for a strong Administrator looking for an immediate start within a supportive team environment. While initially offered as sickness cover, there is potential for the assignment to continue beyond the first month. Interviews are expected to take place as soon as next week.

title: Customer Service Advisor
description:
You must live in Scotland to be considered for this role.

Customer Service Advisor working remotely, on an ongoing contract with the opportunity for extension and opportunity to be made permanent.

Start Date: 9th of November

You will receive full training for this remote working role and all equipment required - you just need wifi and a quiet space to work. (a chair and desk set up)

Working 37-40hrs per week Monday - Sunday (off 2 weekends a month), shifts fall within the hours of 8am - 8pm Monday - Fridays (8hr shifts) and Saturday - Sunday the shifts will fall between the hours of 8am - 6pm. You must be fully flexible to be considered for the role.

Standard hours: £13.49 per hour, overtime: £20.23 per hour.

Duties:
- Inbound customer service relating to maintenance queries and emergency calls
- Logging customer notes on the systems
- Troubleshooting to understand the problem and providing first level advice
- Taking call out payments over the telephone where required
- Complaint handling where required
- Taking full ownership of a call, ensuring the customer receives the highest levels of customer service
- Making customers aware of other products available at the end of the call

What you'll bring with you:
- Excellent IT skills, you will be required to navigate several systems
- Customer service skills, ensuring empathy and good communication
- Listening skills
- Confidence, you will be required to make customers feel at ease and reassure them that their problem is being dealt with

You will need to pass both a criminal background and financial check.

Essential: wifi and a work station set up at home to be successful in this role.

title: Receptionist
description:
Receptionist

St Andrews 12.82 per hour Full-Time Monday to Friday 8:30am - 5:00pm Temporary until at least the end of December, with the potential for extension

We are currently recruiting for a professional and customer-focused Receptionist to join a well-established organisation based in St Andrews. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys being the face of a business and delivering a first-class experience to visitors, clients, and colleagues.

Working within a professional office environment, you will be the first point of contact for all visitors and incoming enquiries, ensuring a warm, welcoming, and efficient service at all times.

Key Responsibilities
- Greeting and welcoming visitors and guests in a professional and friendly manner
- Managing visitor sign-ins and ensuring a positive first impression
- Handling inbound telephone calls and directing enquiries appropriately
- Taking and relaying accurate messages
- Managing calendars, appointments, and meeting room bookings
- Coordinating visitor and meeting arrangements
- Supporting the wider team with general administrative duties
- Maintaining a tidy and professional reception area

About You
- Previous reception, front-of-house, administration, or customer service experience
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
- Professional, approachable, and welcoming manner
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to multitask
- Confident using Microsoft Office and managing calendars
- Reliable and able to work independently

What's on Offer?
- 12.82 per hour
- Full-time hours, Monday to Friday
- Immediate start available
- Friendly and professional working environment
- Temporary assignment through to at least the end of December
- Potential for the role to be extended
- Excellent location with good public transport links

If you thrive in a customer-facing role and enjoy creating a positive experience for every visitor, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Administrator (HR)
description:
HR Administrator
Based in Kirkcaldy hybrid working available (Monday & Wednesday in-office days)
Full Time hours Monday to Friday 36 hours per week
ASAP start
Ongoing Temp role initially strong potential to become permanent
Pay rate up to 14.50 per hour + holiday pay (depending on experience)
Search Consultancy are delighted to be partnered exclusively with a leading business in Fife to recruit this role on an initial temp contract with a view to becoming permanent.
The successful candidate will be responsible for providing comprehensive Administration support to the HR team across a number of functions to ensure that the team can provide a professional HR service across the business.
The client is keen to move quickly to fill this role - on this basis only candidates who are available to start immediately or candidates on short notice will be considered.
Duties involved in this role will include:
Acting as a first point of contact for all managers & employees that require support with general HR or Payroll queries
Investigating and escalating payroll queries to the company's payroll provider
Preparing correspondence & documents to be signed-off by the HR Advisors / Head of HR
Administration of Long Service Awards, flexible working requests & early retirement applications
Preparing and maintaining Excel sheets
Collating and verifying pre-employment checks, ensuring they have been completed in line with company policies
Processing of all new starter documentation & contract changes on the company HR system, submitting required documentation to the company's payroll provider
Updating staff details throughout the employee lifecycle
Providing sickness & absence information to managers on request to assist in the monitoring of absence triggers
Assisting in the audit of the HR database to ensure that all information is accurate and up-to-date
Collating and maintaining electronic staff files
General administration for the team including processing of department mail, filing, photocopying & scanning of documents - as well as ad hoc tasks as directed
In order to be considered for this role your skills and experience should include:
Previous experience within an Administration role - this experience is ESSENTIAL - candidates with previous HR or Recruitment Administration would be preferred, although this is not essential as training would be provided
Excellent interpersonal & communication skills, both written and verbal as you will be dealing with people of all levels within the business daily
Excellent organisation skills, with the ability to prioritise & complete a busy workload effectively and the ability to pivot your focus where required
Solid IT Skills including the full MS office suite (particularly Excel) - HR systems experience would be advantageous
If this is the role for you, apply now!
Please note that only applicants who have the required skills and experience detailed above will be considered for this role.

Search is an equal opportunities recruiter and we welcome applications from all suitably skilled or qualified applicants, regardless of their race, sex, disability, religion/beliefs, sexual orientation or age

title: Receptionist
description:
Job Title: Receptionist

Location: Dunfermline

Hourly Rate: 12.71

Contract Type: Temporary

Responsibilities:
